This duo is the perfect collaboration between your favorite indie brands. Treat yourself and Cheers to Cozy Season Fun Facts - French 75 is a drink that dates back to World War I. Pinot Noir is Karen’s, the founder of Lurid Lacquer's, fav red wine! She and her husband joined a wine club during the pandemic and that's when she really fell in Love with Pinot Noir. polishes.name: Necessities

Ridge Filler helps prevent polish from falling into the nail grooves. Last but not least, all of us nail lovers are very familiar with stained nails and the Neutralizer smooths things out and camouflages yellowing so your nails look like a fresh canvas, every time. Neutralizer – Light purple base that helps with offsetting yellow stained nailsRidge Filler – Light pink that helps fill in nail ridgesSticky Base Coat – Clear sticky base that helps nail adhesion and helps minimize stainingQuick Dry Top Coat – Clear top coat that helps with sealing in your manicure, gives a high gloss finish and plumping effect

polishes.name: Neutralizer
polishes.description: Being a nail polish addict comes with its own set of battle scars, like yellow-stained nails that just won’t quit. We get it. This light purple base coat is here to cancel out that leftover yellow tinge and give your nails a cooler, cleaner vibe. Neutralizer is meant to be worn underneath polish as a base coat that minimizes nail staining showing through your mani. A single coat may show brush strokes. Use multiple coats if you are wearing it solo, or a single coat if using it as a base. Pro Tip - Apply by floating a loaded brush filled with Neutralizer onto the nail. Moss-covered logs, damp forest floors, twisting vines, tiny crawly critters, hidden mushrooms, and the endless shades of green that seem to exist nowhere else on earth. If you've been around here for a while, you already know that greens and pruglies have a permanent place in my heart, so it only felt right to create a collection that feels so me. These aren't your typical summer shades, and honestly, who likes following the rules anyway? polishes.description: Fun Fact - I've never seen a magnetic with a matching base and wanted to make the gunmetal shade pop! This shade was inspired by the fierceness served by the models on Dan McLean Runway. Every time I leave one of her shows I feel instantly inspired. Pro Tip - This is a soft magnetic. Paint first coat in a thin layer let dry, Paint second coat in a thick layer and hover magnet over wet nail immediately at a 45 degree angle for 30-60 sec immediately after painting each nail. When painting top coat hover again for at least 60 seconds. With magnetics it's best to work quick and with one nail at a time. Check out her IG here @danmclean

Rusty Microbe is a unique, metallic rusty copper shade that shifts from green to gold, accented with a delicate dusting of red/green/gold shifting flakes. This polish is a true chameleon, transforming dramatically from indoor to outdoor lighting. But when the sunlight hits it? Pure magic. This is unlike anything in our lineup, and stepping outside our comfort zone has paid off in the most spectacular way. polishes.description: This shade is Limited Edition and can only be purchased on https://hellahandmadecreations.com/ Twilight Tea Party – an enchanting polish continuing on with our Follow Me Down the Indie Rabbit Hole theme for HHC. This mesmerizing shade is a deep, sultry purple, infused with captivating blue aurora shimmers that light up the night. Adding a twist of intrigue, the red magnetic pigments shift and dance at every angle, giving your nails a surreal, glowing effect. Fun, mysterious, and utterly addictive, Twilight Tea Party is the perfect way to start your new year with a little magic and flair. Don’t just fall down the rabbit hole—glow in it! Fun Fact - Lately I have been having a little moment with making soft magnetic pigments. They are so shimmery and beautiful. Pro Tip - Use Mean Green Velveteen for a velvet effect Please note this shade is pre-order from 1/14/25-1/21/25. This shade can only be purchased on Hella Handmade Creations Website.

polishes.name: Walk That Walk
polishes.description: It’s time to stop tiptoeing around and Walk That Walk. This six-piece sizzling neon collection was made for the toes that have been tragically overlooked until now. Whether you’re poolside, beach-bound, or strutting into your next pedicure appointment, these vibrant creams and shimmers are your reminder that self-care starts from the bottom up. Inspired by the Cronies latest obsessions (Ooze and Cheeky Bottoms, anyone?), we knew you needed juicier brights in your life. So go ahead, kick up your feet and paint it loud, shine bold, and bring these to your favorite local nail spot so your manicurist/pedicurist can enjoy painting these for you. Your toes (and your mood) will thank you. Don’t worry, these are made for hands too! Peep Toe – Warm strawberry red creamFoot Worthy – Bright warm orange with purple aurora pigmentsSandals Required – Neon hot pink with purple shimmersFresh Pedicure – Bright blue creamBarefoot Beauty – Fluorescent yellow with green and gold shimmersReady To Stumble – Neon green with blue aurora pigments

polishes.name: Watermelon Halves
polishes.description: Introducing Watermelon Halves, the limited edition duo collaboration from Cracked Polish and Lurid Lacquer! Get ready for the ultimate summer thirst trap. Cracked Polish and Lurid Lacquer have come together again for Watermelon Halves: a juicy, limited-edition duo made to turn heads and tempt hands. One half is a mouthwatering shimmering pink that drips with playful sparkle, the other a bold, eye-striking green that demands attention. Together, they’re ripe, refreshingly expected seeing as we both love to create green and pink colors. Launching this summer and going fast because good fruit doesn’t last forever. Fun Facts - Monique loves watermelon candy, drinks and basically anything artificially watermelon, but can't eat actual watermelon. It's a texture thing. So, she's giving all the bites to you. Karen shared bites with her dog Bam because it was their favorite treat. Cracked Polish contribution: One Bite For You - warm pink packed with gold to pink shimmers and pink aurora pigments. Lurid Lacquer contribution: One Bite For Me - warm green base with green to blue shimmers. Also available 6/20 at 6pm central on luridlacquer.com
